design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (surrender chain). Draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[6, 5, 6]; the root and the charge correction take 6 factors each, the part-year interest takes 5.

1. Why this is a good test. The owner asks only to cash out her SecureRate 7 (traditional IRA). A correct agent must (a) notice in the ledger that the 45,000.00 excess partial withdrawal of 2025-07-22 never received its surrender charge entry, (b) read in the part-year surrender interest rule that the interest waits on every excess partial withdrawal carrying its charge entry, (c) book the corrected charge (60.38) from a six-factor rule evaluated at the withdrawal's own date, (d) credit the part-year surrender interest (3,284.82) on the corrected value with a five-factor rule, and only then (e) work the cash surrender value (153,494.99) from a six-factor rule and hand the confirmation to the owner. Difficulty comes from reading rules, reconciling a six-year ledger and two other products' ledgers, and arithmetic; there is one tool per problem and no near-synonymous tools.

2. Scope. Task 0 is the first task: nothing was occupied. It claims fixed_ext_missed_withdrawal_charge, fixed_ext_surrender_part_year_interest, fixed_ext_surrender_value and tools assess_missed_withdrawal_charge_e9f9c059, credit_surrender_interest_88d8dad0, confirm_full_surrender_fa1c6fc8. Reserved for task 1 (draw: 2 prerequisites, factors [5, 4, 6]): the death benefit line (death claim interest, death-benefit valuation interest, beneficiary settlement), which shares no policy, quantity or tool with this tree.

3. Problem-tree card. Root A = fixed_ext_surrender_value (user tool). Edge A -> B (fixed_ext_surrender_part_year_interest): value_input, gate a_cv, form state, sentence "The cash surrender value is not fixed until the contract carries the part-year interest credited for the surrender." (negated direction: the release of a figure waits on a booked credit). Only B's write books an interest entry dated after the surrender request's receipt, so the state singles out B. Seed proof it is false: latest interest entry d76ec346-5210-4361-ab7f-0307c8e0c274 dated 2026-02-17 < received 2026-10-14. Edge B -> C (fixed_ext_missed_withdrawal_charge): value_input, gate b_cv, form state, sentence "The part-year surrender interest is worked out only after every excess partial withdrawal on the contract carries its surrender charge entry." (affirmative direction). Only C's write creates a partial-withdrawal surrender charge entry. Seed proof: withdrawal c8d6a176-dda6-4641-9316-bd5bbbe21206 type excess_partial under request 7fc85467-909d-434c-a806-6eda027431a1, no fixed_surrender_charge_assessed row exists. Topological order C, B, A (a chain, no parallel pair). Deletion sensitivity (actual run): skip B -> cash surrender value 150,217.02 (gold 153,494.99); skip C -> interest 3,286.13 (gold 3,284.82). User tool: A is the owner's own confirmation of the surrender; it is completed on the spot. The persona names neither prerequisite; tools validate nothing (no conditions in task_tools.py).
Four-point test: both sentences carry an ordering connective (not until / only after), wait on a record-visible state (an interest entry for the surrender; a surrender charge entry for every excess partial withdrawal), name no tool, id or code token, and are hard requirements matching `condition`. Derivation: sentence + ledger (no charge entry on the excess withdrawal) + the correction rule (it books exactly that entry) -> C; sentence + ledger (no interest after 2026-02-17) + the interest rule (it credits the part-year interest for the surrender) -> B.

4. Base-invariant card. Step 10 subject fixed_surrender_charge_assessed: fixed_evt_withdrawal and fixed_surrender govern it with no applicable gate (policy_scope). Step 12 subject fixed_interest_credited: fixed_interest_crediting, policy_scope. Step 14 subjects fixed_contract_surrendered/fixed_surrender_paid: fixed_surrender.signed_surrender_request — request f032c2d5-71ef-48b8-969b-56b7a22ef5b4 full_surrender, signed 2026-10-10, received 2026-10-14, status received, owner-signed; the only beneficiary line is revocable (no irrevocable consent needed); fixed_sc_waivers' gate sentence is superseded by the surrender value policy (a waiver claim is needed only where a waiver is relied on; none is). No time gate applies to these subjects. Overwrites declared: effective-date sentence of fixed_surrender (the surrender takes effect, and the cash surrender value is worked, on the handling date; the part-year interest runs to the end date of its own ladder), the part-year crediting clause of fixed_interest_crediting, free percentage clause (fixed_evt_withdrawal; the free_withdrawal_first_contract_year gate and the first-year initial-premium base are kept in both free-amount sentences), RMD-counting clause (fixed_evt_rmd_and_systematic), schedule-percentage clauses (fixed_evt_withdrawal, fixed_surrender), premium tax deduction (fixed_surrender), interest rate and convention clauses (fixed_interest_crediting), waiver gate (fixed_sc_waivers).

5. Business-object card. Target: contract FA41738264 (c53e1362-ad09-4654-9af7-19c3883e3fcf). Correction object: the 2025-07-22 excess withdrawal and its request 7fc85467-909d-434c-a806-6eda027431a1 (the two RMD requests are completed RMDs that owe no charge). Interest object: the part year from the 2026-02-17 credit. Surrender object: request f032c2d5-71ef-48b8-969b-56b7a22ef5b4. Rows aggregated: prior-contract-year rows (after 2024-11-16) for the 203,396.51 anniversary value; current-contract-year rows (after 2025-11-16) for 156,378.36; RMD rows excluded from free-amount usage by rule; whole life premiums and income installments in the last 12 months for the relationship tiers.

6. Factor card (tier taken / evidence / baseline figure). C: free percentage 0.15 (annuitant 72 on 2024-11-16, schedule year 5) -> baseline 102.75; RMD excluded from usage (7,704.28 RMD of 2025-02-18) -> 92.48; cap 0.03 (age 73) -> 108.68; whole life relationship -0.005 (WL40562817 in force, 12 payments; near miss 2025-09-20 outside 12 months) -> 72.45; monthly grading 4/12 -> 181.13; late share 0.5 (451 days, age 74) -> 120.75; all baseline 1,618.23. B: end date through 2026-10-15 (lag 2) -> 3,271.13; closing-years +0.002 -> 3,085.74; income relationship +0.001 (IA40917735, 12 installments; near miss 2025-10-01) -> 3,185.28 [cross income]; withdrawal history -0.001 (excess within 24 months) -> 3,384.36; simple-interest convention (age 74, 240 days) -> 3,266.52; all baseline 3,056.66. A: free percentage 0.15 -> 153,478.70; RMD excluded (6,155.61) -> 153,482.17; cap 0.03 -> 153,385.65; whole life relationship -> 153,440.32 [cross whole]; monthly grading 1/12 -> 150,488.06; premium tax 0.005 x 180,000 (issued CA, IRA) -> 154,394.99; all baseline 148,860.91. Multi-source factors: free percentages, relationships, grading, closing-years, convention, late share, premium tax. Cross-difficulty: whole (A, C) and income (B).

7. World rows. Customer Dolores Whitcombe (phone 5025550147, SSN 7316, ZIP 40205, DOB 1952-03-14). Contract: SR7 traditional IRA issued 2020-11-16 in CA, 180,000.00, rate 0.0310, schedule start 2020-11-16, RMD 2026 posted 6,155.61 (31-Dec-2025 value 156,968.06 / 25.5). Ledger: premium, beneficiary line, anniversary credits 2021-2025, part-year credits on each withdrawal date, RMD 2025 7,704.28, excess 45,000.00 (charge never booked and no free portion recorded on the row, so nothing on the record names the free amount), RMD 2026. Whole life WL40562817 in force, 13 monthly EFT premiums (12 in window). Income annuity IA40917735 10-Year Certain in payout, 13 installments (12 in window). Removing the whole life rows drops the relationship tiers (C 72.45, A 153,440.32); removing the income rows drops the income addition (B 3,185.28); removing the excess withdrawal removes edge B->C. No base automatic clause is ignited: no renewal window (GP ends 2027-11-15), RMD 2026 already satisfied, no systematic plan, whole life paid to 2026-10-20, income annuity current.

8. Persona. Polite, slow, formal retired librarian; volunteers only the goal (cash out and close the annuity), her phone number and the fact that she mailed the signed form; credentials, contract number and payout preference only on request; passive consent to anything Ashgrove must take care of first; runs the confirmation with the figures the agent reads; closes when told it is surrendered. Her memory of 'a little over one hundred fifty-six thousand dollars' is the 2025-11-16 anniversary value (156,378.36) and is true.

9. Standard solution and verification (actual run of the recomputation over the handling-time world with the real tools, check_compute machinery): step 10 charge_amount = 60.38; step 12 interest_amount = 3,284.82 on 151,383.53; step 14 cash_surrender_value = 153,494.99 on 154,668.35. Gates run per task: check_extended, check_task_tools, replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_compute, check_grounding, check_cross_fire all OK.

10. Draft recomputation from the visible context. Using only the rules' prose, the tool schemas, the finder returns and the persona: the surrender value rule says it waits on the part-year interest; the interest rule says it waits on every excess partial withdrawal carrying its charge entry; the ledger shows one excess withdrawal without one; the correction rule's ladders fix 60.38; the interest rule fixes 240 days at 3.30 percent simple = 3,284.82; the surrender rule fixes 153,494.99. Same objects, order and parameters as gold; payout direct_deposit is what she states and what her request carries.

Revision log: (r1) seed FK fields written as empty strings were flagged dangling by replay_tasks -> empty *_id fields now null -> REPLAY OK.

Rework round 2 (policy-task audit): F-C1(a) — P2 and P3 now declare the base effective-date sentence of fixed_surrender (and P2 the part-year crediting clause of fixed_interest_crediting) as superseded; P3's anchor sentence reads 'The surrender takes effect on the date it is handled, and the cash surrender value is worked out on that date.' (also consistent with the tool's termination_date = handling date). F-C1(b) — P1 and P3 free-amount sentences and compute restore the free_withdrawal_first_contract_year gate and the first-year initial-premium base (no effect on this world: contract years 5 and 6). 0.md finding 2 — the excess withdrawal row no longer carries free_portion_amount (blank), so neither free-amount factor can be read off a stamp. 0.md finding 3 — factor_trace figure corrected to 22,805.20 (= 30,509.48 - 7,704.28). All scored values unchanged: 60.38 / 3,284.82 / 153,494.99; gates re-run green.
user_scenario: You are Dolores Whitcombe, a 74-year-old retired middle-school librarian in Louisville, Kentucky, calling Ashgrove Mutual Life from your kitchen phone. You speak slowly and politely, a little formally, and you like to have figures read back to you so you can write them on the pad by the phone. You open by saying you are calling about your Ashgrove annuity, the SecureRate one you bought back when you still lived in California, and that you want to cash it out and close it. You mailed the signed surrender form last weekend and Ashgrove's letter said it arrived, and now you would like to get the money and be done with it; you want the whole thing closed today, not a partial withdrawal and not a new guarantee. When the representative asks how to find you, you give your phone number, 5025550147. Only when you are asked to confirm who you are do you give your date of birth, March 14, 1952 (1952-03-14), the last four of your Social Security number, 7316, and your ZIP code, 40205; you give each one only when it is asked for. If the representative asks for the contract number you read it off your statement: FA41738264. If asked how you want to be paid you say: Direct deposit to my checking account, same as on the form. You do not know what the annuity is worth today; you only remember that the statement you got last November showed a little over one hundred fifty-six thousand dollars. You also have a whole life policy and an income annuity with Ashgrove; you say so only if the representative asks, and you have nothing to change on either. You tell the representative that whatever has to be done on Ashgrove's side to close the annuity properly, they may go ahead and do it; if the representative explains that something else has to be taken care of on the contract before the surrender, you say that is fine and ask them to go ahead. When the representative tells you the cash surrender value and hands you the step to confirm the surrender, you confirm it yourself, using exactly the contract number, request number, amount and payment method the representative reads to you, and you read the confirmation back. Once the representative tells you the annuity has been surrendered and the money is on its way by direct deposit, you thank them warmly and say goodbye. You never suggest what the representative should check or calculate, and if a figure is quoted you simply write it down.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (surrender value <- part-year interest <- charge correction); no problem has two prerequisites, so there is no parallel pair to reorder. The order is entailed by the two prerequisite sentences: the interest waits on every excess partial withdrawal carrying its charge entry, and the surrender value waits on the part-year interest credited for the surrender.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the interest credit leaves the contract value at 151,383.53 when the surrender is valued: cash surrender value 150,217.02 instead of 153,494.99, and the terminal ledger lacks the interest entry.

Skipping the correction leaves the contract value at 151,443.91: part-year interest 3,286.13 instead of 3,284.82, and the terminal ledger lacks the charge entry (and the surrender value then differs as well).

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only to cash out and close the annuity. It never mentions a surrender charge, the 2025 withdrawal, a correction, interest or any crediting; its only related line is passive — if the representative explains that something else has to be taken care of on the contract before the surrender, she agrees. Neither prerequisite problem id nor its subject appears in user_scenario.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: confirm_full_surrender_fa1c6fc8 updates the contract to surrendered, creates the surrender payment and completes the request with whatever cash_surrender_value is passed; it never looks for an interest entry. credit_surrender_interest_88d8dad0 creates the interest entry and raises the contract value without looking for charge entries. Neither returns an error or a hint when its prerequisite is unresolved (task_tools.py function bodies contain no condition at all).
